reference: Amin MB, Edge SB, Greene FL, et al., eds. AJCC Cancer Staging Manual. 8th ed. Springer; 2017.

t_stages.description: Minimally invasive adenocarcinoma (<=3 cm, <=5 mm invasion)
Tumor >3 cm but <=4 cm; or involves main bronchus without carina; or invades visceral pleura; or associated with partial atelectasis
Tumor >5 cm but <=7 cm; or direct invasion of chest wall, phrenic nerve, parietal pericardium; or separate tumor nodule(s) in same lobe

Tumor >7 cm; or invasion of diaphragm, mediastinum, heart, great vessels, trachea, recurrent laryngeal nerve, esophagus, vertebral body, or carina; or separate tumor nodule(s) in different ipsilateral lobe

n_stages.description: No regional lymph node metastasis
Metastasis in ipsilateral peribronchial and/or ipsilateral hilar lymph nodes and intrapulmonary nodes
Metastasis in ipsilateral mediastinal and/or subcarinal lymph nodes
Metastasis in contralateral mediastinal, contralateral hilar, ipsilateral or contralateral scalene, or supraclavicular lymph nodes

m_stages.description: Separate tumor nodule(s) in contralateral lobe; tumor with pleural or pericardial nodules or malignant pleural or pericardial effusion
Single extrathoracic metastasis in a single organ
Multiple extrathoracic metastases in one or several organs

stage_groups.tnm: T1a-c/T2a/T2b N1 M0 or T3 N0 M0
T1a-c/T2a/T2b N2 M0 or T3 N1 M0 or T4 N0/N1 M0
T1a-c/T2a/T2b N3 M0 or T3/T4 N2 M0

t_stages.description: Extension to chest wall (not including pectoralis muscle)
Ulceration and/or ipsilateral satellite nodules and/or edema (including peau d'orange) of the skin

n_stages.description: No regional lymph node metastasis
Micrometastases (>0.2 mm and/or >200 cells, <=2.0 mm)
Metastasis in 1-3 axillary lymph nodes; and/or internal mammary nodes with metastasis detected by sentinel lymph node biopsy
Metastasis in 4-9 axillary lymph nodes (at least 1 tumor deposit >2.0 mm)
Metastasis in clinically detected internal mammary lymph nodes without axillary lymph node metastasis
Metastasis in >=10 axillary lymph nodes; or metastasis to the infraclavicular nodes
Metastasis in clinically detected ipsilateral internal mammary lymph nodes with axillary lymph node metastasis
Metastasis in ipsilateral supraclavicular lymph nodes

m_stages.description: No clinical or radiographic evidence of distant metastases

No clinical or radiographic evidence of distant metastases in the presence of tumor cells or deposits <=0.2 mm detected microscopically or by molecular techniques in circulating blood, bone marrow, or other nonregional nodal tissue
Distant metastases detected by clinical or radiographic means and/or histologically proven >0.2 mm

stage_groups.tnm: T0/T1 N1 M0 or T2 N0 M0
T2 N1 M0 or T3 N0 M0
T0/T1/T2 N2 M0 or T3 N1/N2 M0

t_stages.description: Carcinoma in situ, intramucosal carcinoma (involvement of lamina propria with no extension through muscularis mucosae)
Tumor invades submucosa (through muscularis mucosae but not into muscularis propria)
Tumor invades through the muscularis propria into pericolorectal tissues
Tumor penetrates to the surface of the visceral peritoneum
Tumor directly invades or is adherent to other organs or structures

n_stages.description: No regional lymph node metastasis
Metastasis in 1 regional lymph node
Metastasis in 2-3 regional lymph nodes
Tumor deposit(s) in the subserosa, mesentery, or nonperitonealized pericolic or perirectal/mesorectal tissues without regional nodal metastasis
Metastasis in 4-6 regional lymph nodes
Metastasis in 7 or more regional lymph nodes

m_stages.description: No distant metastasis by imaging; no evidence of tumor in distant sites or organs
Metastasis to one site or organ without peritoneal metastasis
Metastasis to two or more sites or organs without peritoneal metastasis
Metastasis to the peritoneal surface alone or with other site or organ metastases

stage_groups.tnm: T1/T2 N1/N1c M0 or T1 N2a M0
T3/T4a N1/N1c M0 or T2/T3 N2a M0 or T1/T2 N2b M0
T4a N2a M0 or T3/T4a N2b M0 or T4b N1/N2 M0

t_stages.description: Breslow thickness <0.8 mm with ulceration; or 0.8-1.0 mm with or without ulceration

n_stages.description: No regional lymph node metastasis; no in-transit, satellite, or microsatellite metastases
One clinically occult (SLN biopsy) regional lymph node metastasis; no in-transit, satellite, or microsatellite metastases
One clinically detected regional lymph node metastasis; no in-transit, satellite, or microsatellite metastases
No regional lymph node metastasis; presence of in-transit, satellite, and/or microsatellite metastases
Two or three clinically occult (SLN biopsy) regional lymph node metastases; no in-transit, satellite, or microsatellite metastases
Two or three regional lymph node metastases, at least one clinically detected; no in-transit, satellite, or microsatellite metastases
One clinically occult or detected regional lymph node metastasis; presence of in-transit, satellite, and/or microsatellite metastases
Four or more clinically occult (SLN biopsy) regional lymph node metastases; no in-transit, satellite, or microsatellite metastases
Four or more regional lymph node metastases, at least one clinically detected, or matted nodes; no in-transit, satellite, or microsatellite metastases
Two or more clinically occult or detected regional lymph node metastases and/or matted nodes; presence of in-transit, satellite, and/or microsatellite metastases

m_stages.description: Distant metastasis to skin, soft tissue including muscle, and/or non-regional lymph node
Distant metastasis to lung with or without M1a sites of disease
Distant metastasis to non-CNS visceral sites with or without M1a or M1b sites of disease
Distant metastasis to CNS with or without M1a, M1b, or M1c sites of disease

stage_groups.tnm: T0 N1b/N1c M0 or T1a/T1b/T2a N1b/N1c/N2b M0 or T2b/T3a N1a-N2b M0
T1a-T3a N2c/N3 M0 or T3b/T4a Any N>=N1 M0 or T4b N1a-N2c M0

prognostic_factors.ulceration: Present or absent; upgrades T subcategory
prognostic_factors.mitotic_rate: Number of mitoses/mm2; prognostic but no longer part of staging in 8th edition
prognostic_factors.sentinel_lymph_node_status: Most important prognostic factor for Stage I/II
prognostic_factors.ldh: Elevated LDH worsens prognosis in Stage IV (M1 subcategory suffix)

ldh_substaging.description: Each M1 subcategory is further classified by LDH level

suffixes.description: LDH elevated above upper limit of normal
